    toc: true

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '/fh/fast/sun_w/yub/tcr/tracerx/tcr-seq')
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r}
create_plots <- function(df) {
  # Total number of TCRs per sample
  ntcr_per_sample = df |> 
    group_by(chain, sample_name) |>
    summarise(ntcr = n(), .groups = 'drop')
  p1 = ggplot(ntcr_per_sample, aes(chain, ntcr)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_jitter() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = '', y = 'Number of TCRs per sample') +
    theme_pubr()
  # Number of unique TCRs per sample
  n_unique_tcr_per_sample = df |> 
    group_by(chain, sample_name) |>
    summarise(n_unique_tcr = length(unique(cdr3_aa)), .groups = 'drop')
  p2 = ggplot(n_unique_tcr_per_sample, aes(chain, n_unique_tcr)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_jitter() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = '', y = 'Total number of unique TCRs perf sample') +
    theme_pubr()
  # Correlation between number of alpha & beta TCRs
  data_compare_ntcr = ntcr_per_sample |> 
    mutate(region = sapply(strsplit(sample_name, '_TR'), head, n = 1)) |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = 'region', names_from = 'chain', values_from = 'ntcr')
  p3 = ggplot(data_compare_ntcr, aes(A, B)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = 'red') +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    theme_pubr()
  # Combine
  ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, nrow = 1)
}
```

## Descriptive statistics from the original paper

See <https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-019-0592-2/figures/7> for the original description.

Below is the description based on the data I processed.

## Load TCR

```{r Load TCR}
tcr = readRDS('df_tcr.rds')
```

## For tumors

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=6}
create_plots(tcr |> filter(tissue == 'Lung tumour'))
```

## For non-tumor lung

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=6}
create_plots(tcr |> filter(tissue == 'Non-tumour Lung'))
```

## For blood

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=6}
create_plots(tcr |> filter(tissue == 'Blood'))
```
